scientific_question: Can differentiable elimination of the low-dimensional Ritz coefficients retain the physical overlapping-recoupling advantage during backbone training?
promotion_rule: Square physical variable projection must beat raw and one-Lanczos medians, beat the matched in-A1 isospectral scramble in median energy, median variance, and every paired seed, and put every physical seed below 1e-5. Triangular N12 must remain below the numerical 1e-10 floor. Only then may a separate untouched audit be created.

change steps, learning rate, operator count, or gates after seeing results
claim scalable VMC performance from the dense exact-small Hamiltonian
